17: /// Serve newline-delimited JSON-RPC requests on stdin and responses on stdout.
18: pub fn serve() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
19:     let stdin = io::stdin();
20:     let mut stdout = io::BufWriter::new(io::stdout().lock());
21:     for line in stdin.lock().lines() {
22:         let line = line?;
23:         if line.trim().is_empty() {
24:             continue;
25:         }
26:         if let Some(response) = handle_message(&line) {
27:             serde_json::to_writer(&mut stdout, &response)?;
28:             stdout.write_all(b"\n")?;
29:             stdout.flush()?;
30:         }
31:     }
32:     Ok(())
33: }

35: fn handle_message(line: &str) -> Option<Value> {
36:     let request: Value = match serde_json::from_str(line) {
37:         Ok(value) => value,
38:         Err(error) => return Some(json_rpc_error(Value::Null, -32700, error.to_string())),
39:     };
40:     let object = match request.as_object() {
41:         Some(object) => object,
42:         None => {
43:             return Some(json_rpc_error(
44:                 Value::Null,
45:                 -32600,
46:                 "request must be an object",
47:             ))
48:         }
49:     };
50:     if object.get("jsonrpc").and_then(Value::as_str) != Some("2.0") {
51:         return Some(json_rpc_error(
52:             object.get("id").cloned().unwrap_or(Value::Null),
53:             -32600,
54:             "jsonrpc must be \"2.0\"",
55:         ));
56:     }
57:     let id = object.get("id").cloned().unwrap_or(Value::Null);
58:     let notification = !object.contains_key("id");
59:     let method = match object.get("method").and_then(Value::as_str) {
60:         Some(method) => method,
61:         None => {
62:             return (!notification)
63:                 .then(|| json_rpc_error(id, -32600, "request method is required"))
64:         }
65:     };
66: 
67:     match method {
68:         "initialize" => Some(json_rpc_result(id, initialize_result())),
69:         "notifications/initialized" | "notifications/cancelled" => None,
70:         "tools/list" => Some(json_rpc_result(id, json!({"tools": tool_definitions()}))),
71:         "tools/call" => {
72:             if notification {
73:                 return None;
74:             }
75:             let params = match object.get("params").and_then(Value::as_object) {
76:                 Some(params) => params,
77:                 None => {
78:                     return Some(json_rpc_error(
79:                         id,
80:                         -32602,
81:                         "tools/call params must be an object",
82:                     ))
83:                 }
84:             };
85:             match call_tool(params) {
86:                 Ok(result) => Some(json_rpc_result(id, result)),
87:                 Err(CallError::Invalid(message)) => Some(json_rpc_error(id, -32602, message)),
88:                 Err(CallError::Service(error)) => {
89:                     Some(json_rpc_result(id, service_error_result(error)))
90:                 }
91:                 Err(CallError::Internal(message)) => Some(json_rpc_error(id, -32603, message)),
92:             }
93:         }
94:         _ if notification => None,
95:         _ => Some(json_rpc_error(
96:             id,
97:             -32601,
98:             format!("method not found: {method}"),
99:         )),
100:     }
101: }
